model_output.rationale: All three lines denied CO-16 with MOA N286 (missing/incomplete/invalid referring provider primary identifier). The 837P lists billing and rendering providers but no referring/ordering provider loop. This is a data defect on an adjudicated Medicare Part B claim. Eligibility was active on DOS. Correct and resubmit as a new original (CLM05-3=1) with the referring provider NPI populated.

root_cause.explanation: All three lines carry CO-16 + MOA N286. The 837P has no referring/ordering provider loop. Medicare Part B requires a referring provider NPI for therapy claims billed at POS 11.

next_action.detail: Add the ordering/referring provider name and NPI (verified against PECOS) to the 837P. Submit as a new original CLM05-3=1 — Medicare Part B does not accept frequency 7. Timely filing clock is running; DOS 2026-07-20, deadline 2027-07-20.

evidence.fact: MOA N286 at claim level; CO-16 on all three lines totaling $220.86 paid $0
